title: Echoes of the Heartstone
premise: Mika studies the foundations of magic in an old sanctuary. The Heartstone answers her spells with a heartbeat that sounds incomplete. Old books, a hidden sign and a still pond hold the pattern it has forgotten.

heartbeat.title: A heartbeat with a beat missing
heartbeat.hint: The Heartstone answered my orb with two slow pulses.

daybook.title: The Keeper's Daybook
daybook.hint: Aurel wrote that the stone should beat three times.

margin_note.title: A note signed 'A.'
margin_note.hint: Someone signed 'A.' knew the stone answers the orb.

sign_location.title: Where the sign is
sign_location.hint: A sign of return is carved by the forest gate.

gate_mark.title: The Sign of Return, woken
gate_mark.hint: The marked stone by the gate woke under a rune of light.

water_remembers.title: What the water remembers
water_remembers.hint: Still water holds the light of a sign.

pond_pattern.title: The pattern in the pond
pond_pattern.hint: The pond showed a seven-pointed pattern in its rings.

stages.title: The Quiet Stone
stages.objective: Study the sanctuary and its relic.

stages.title: The Stone Stirs
stages.objective: Find out why the Heartstone's heartbeat sounds incomplete.

stages.title: The Sign of Return
stages.objective: Carry the shape of the sign to still water.

stages.title: What Water Remembers
stages.objective: Bring the remembered pattern back to the Heartstone.

stages.title: Echo
stages.objective: The Heartstone is awake. The ritual circle answers more strongly now.

unlock.summary: The Heartstone beat three times. The ritual circle now amplifies every spell cast inside it, and a second inscription has appeared on the chamber tablet.
